facts.fact: The Government Action Programme 2021-2026 carries a project, Transformation numérique des collectivités locales, whose expected results include town halls and prefectures connected to the Administration's network, with the connection of communes to the network scheduled for 2023-2026 after studies in 2022; dated to the document's publication year.

The programme costs the local-government digital project at FCFA 21 billion, of which FCFA 7 billion from the national budget, FCFA 8 billion from public-private partnership and FCFA 6 billion from KfW; dated to the document's publication year.

The programme places the local-government digital project, including connection of town halls to the Administration's network, under the Ministry of Digital Affairs and Digitalisation, executed by the state agency ASSI; dated to the document's publication year.

The programme reports as done under the 2016-2021 programme a digital network dedicated to the public administration interconnecting 187 decentralised sites across the country, which it lists as tax collection offices, town halls, prefectures and others; it does not say how many of the 187 are town halls, and sets their connection as a result still expected for 2021-2026. Dated to the document's publication year.

The programme gives 187 sites on the Administration's network, town halls among several kinds of office listed, with no count of town halls or communes connected; dated to the document's publication year.
